# 将人员从某个脸库中移到未绑定脸库
##### 简要描述

- 传递字段UniqueID时，可不传PersonID，若两个参数都传，接口将校验这两个参数必须匹配到同一条记录

| 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| DstGroupID | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">目标脸库ID</span> | 是 |
| SrcGroupID | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">当解绑操作时，该值无意义，但是绑定操作时，该值表示源脸库ID</span> | 是 |
| PersonID | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">PersonID，对于添加人员信息时，PersonID默认为0，对于修改人员信息时,使用对应的人员信息PersonID</span> | 是 |
| UniqueID | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">人员唯一标识ID，最大长度32，不可为空</span> | 是 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceGroup/UnBindPersonInfo HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 4f0daacc-31e2-4ff6-9d59-a2e82f7c855e
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 285

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<PersonInfoList>
<PersonInfo>
<DstGroupID>1</DstGroupID>.
<SrcGroupID>0</SrcGroupID>
<PersonID>1</PersonID>
<UniqueID>969454ae-c374-c3fb-79aa-01695aff3236</UniqueID>
</PersonInfo>
</PersonInfoList>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 193

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceGroup/UnBindPersonInfo</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceGroup/UnBindPersonInfo` 

##### 请求方式

- put
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
{}

```
